types.name: TextRevealProps
types.doc: Reveals a short headline or sentence once, as it mounts: each word rises out of its own clip while it sharpens from a soft blur. The entrance runs in CSS, so it starts on first paint, never waits for hydration, and never leaves text hidden when scripts are slow. Use `\n` in `text` for a deliberate line break and change the element's `key` to replay it.
